source: DHM Islamic Level 1 · lesson 14 «How We Pray» (11 steps). Sacred sayings are flagged and their audio waits for Dr. Hassan's review.
topic: Step 3: bowing — what we do and what we say

words.en: Glory be to my Lord, the Most Great

order.en: Put the steps of the prayer in order

quiz.en: What do we do in rukū‘?
opts: Bend forward and hold both knees, back straight

quiz.en: What do we say in rukū‘?
opts: Glory be to my Lord, the Most High
Glory be to my Lord, the Most Great

quiz.en: How many times do we say it?

move.en: Bow with Koko: hands on your knees, back flat like a table!

parents.summary: Rukū‘ (bowing): hands on the knees, back straight, and saying Subḥāna Rabbiya l-ʿAẓīm three times.

try.en: Glory be to my Lord, the Most Great

parents.tip: Ask him to show you rukū‘. Check his back is flat and that he says it three times.
